svg.title: A programmable multimodal workbench
svg.desc: Logical exploded view of the target platform architecture. A shared command boundary is accessible to researchers and code/AI clients. Mutable intent, frozen revisions, execution, source artifacts, associations/alignments and derived evidence remain distinct. Provider examples are schematic and do not imply validated device integration.

g.data-label: Structured research objects. Replaceable providers. Traceable outputs.
